title: French Pan-Seared Bacon
description: A simple and delicious French dish featuring crispy bacon, cooked in a skillet.

instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Cut the bacon into strips and wrap each strip in a lamina.
Place the wrapped bacon in the skillet and cook until crispy.
Remove the bacon from the skillet and set aside.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
